2126038160282947993.en_summary: At least 60% to 70% of the signers aren't from Cochise County, per the county supervisor. Elon reposted it twice tonight. The people trying to stop SpaceX's Arizona data center don't even live there. Locals pay about $130M a year for power. SpaceX says the project adds $260M a year of margin to their power company at full build-out. That's twice their bill. Their power company is a co-op, so that money goes to them. This one could send them a check. Plus 1,000 jobs. Chips aren't the bottleneck for AI anymore. Permission to build is. SpaceX is the only one paying the neighbors for it. 9 Dec hearing. $SPCX
